import unittest
from quota.model import Request
from quota.coordinator import Coordinator
from quota.store import ShardStore
class Public(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_atomic_rollback_and_idempotency(self):
  s=ShardStore({'a':5,'b':5}); c=Coordinator(s); s.fail_on.add('b')
  with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError): c.reserve(Request('r1',{'a':3,'b':2}))
  self.assertEqual(s.capacities,{'a':5,'b':5}); s.fail_on.clear()
  self.assertTrue(c.reserve(Request('r1',{'a':3,'b':2})))
  self.assertTrue(c.reserve(Request('r1',{'a':3,'b':2})))
  self.assertEqual(s.capacities,{'a':2,'b':3})
 def test_insufficient_capacity(self):
  s=ShardStore({'a':1}); c=Coordinator(s)
  with self.assertRaises(ValueError): c.reserve(Request('x',{'a':2}))
  self.assertEqual(s.capacities['a'],1)
